engine: bydorr's signature text reveal — a TYPEWRITER FRONT that advances left-to-right on scroll: a SOLID settled head, a NARROW scramble EDGE (3-5 chars: translucent horizontal smear — extra letter-spacing + slight rightward x-drift + slight shrink + fade — collapsing to settled), and the ENTIRE REST OF THE PASSAGE AHEAD IS INVISIBLE (opacity 0, NOT a grey floor — the whole text is never shown at once). NO vertical move, NO rotation -> stable + liquid. A scroll-scrubbed per-glyph reveal where unrevealed chars don't exist on screen yet. Harvested from D_bydorr (the 'Feel because you have a heart...' poem: only 'Feel because you hav[e a h]' shows mid-reveal, the rest is blank white).

measured_teardown.move: one pinned scroll-scrub, progress p 0..1. The text is split into per-character spans (spaces preserved). Each char i owns a SHORT window [i/N*spread .. +charWin] along p (left-to-right cascade, spread = 1-charWin, charWin ~0.07 so only ~3-5 chars are mid-flight at once = a narrow typewriter front). Before its window a char is opacity 0 = INVISIBLE (the rest of the passage is not shown). Inside its window it eases (power3.out) via a BASELINE-LOCKED HORIZONTAL COLLAPSE: opacity = sqrt(lp) 0->1 (faster than the spatial collapse, so the head reads solid while the edge is still faint); letterSpacing (inv^2)*(0.08+0.20k) em -> 0; translate3d X = inv*(chaos*0.13 + chaos*0.32k) px rightward -> 0 (Y and Z pinned to 0); scale 1-inv*(0.06+0.05k) -> 1. NO translateY, NO rotation at any p (verified 0.00px vertical move). Per-char variety from a deterministic seed c.__k in [0,1] scaling magnitude only. FIX HISTORY: build 1 scattered chars (random dx/dy + rotation) -> vertical teleport; build 2 collapse-model but with a 0.10 opacity FLOOR + wide window -> the WHOLE passage showed grey at once (wrong format). FINAL: opacity 0 ahead-of-edge (invisible) + narrow window = a true typewriter front matching bydorr.
measured_teardown.cited: bydorr: 'Feel because you have a heart / And let it guide you through the dark / For it's the well of emotions deep / That helps you laugh, love, and sleep.' — head solid, edge characters jumbled/rotating into place, revealed left-to-right as you scroll; a faint X/Y crosshair readout + a 'W.' honors marker sit alongside (not part of this brick).

chaos.what: scales the edge x-smear (rightward drift = inv*(chaos*0.13 + chaos*0.32*k) px) — NOT a 2D scatter anymore (no Y, no rotation). Bigger = a longer horizontal smear tail. ~30-40 reads like bydorr.

charWin.what: fraction of total progress each char takes to fade+collapse (its window length). SMALL on purpose: with N chars only ~charWin*N/spread chars are mid-flight at once = a NARROW typewriter edge; everything ahead is invisible. Bigger => wider edge + more of the passage visible at once (avoid — that's the grey-whole-text failure).

pinFactor.what: length of the pinned scroll span = how long the whole passage takes to assemble.

seed.what: deterministic scramble seed — same seed => same per-char scramble vectors (stable, no jitter).

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when the page drives a shared Lenis (lab sets false).

entry: ScrambleSettleText.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), chars, destroy }. target = .sst-stage wrapping .sst-text (plain text, or [data-line] blocks for explicit lines). The JS splits the text into .sst-char spans. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub (0 all scrambled, 1 all settled).
law: transform: translate3d X + scale per char + opacity + letterSpacing only; GPU (X/Y/Z translate composited); NO translateY, NO rotation, NO filter / NO mix-blend; NO WebGL; reduced-motion or <=820px -> all settled (no pin). owns_pin TRUE. Seeds (c.__k) are deterministic (PRNG seeded once) — never Math.random per frame. GSAP + ScrollTrigger required for the scroll path; set(p) standalone.
gate_mode: owns_pin scroll-scrub. THREE gates: (1) FORMAT — at a mid p the bulk of the passage AHEAD of the edge is opacity 0 (invisible), NOT grey; only a SOLID head + a NARROW (~3-5 char) scramble edge show. hiddenAt0 == true (nothing visible before scroll). (2) STABILITY — maxVerticalMove == 0 and NO rotation at any p. (3) SETTLE — every char opacity 1 + scale 1 + letter-spacing 0 at p=1. Smoothness with the full char count transforming per frame.
proven: lab: a 4-line UA passage (62 chars) on white paper. FORMAT verified: at p=0.4 -> 35 chars invisible (ahead, opacity 0) / 24 settled (solid head) / 3 in-flight (the narrow edge); hiddenAt0 = true (blank before scroll). STABILITY: maxVerticalMove = 0.00px, no rotation across p. SETTLE: all chars opacity 1 + scale 1 + letterSpacing 0 at p=1. Mid screenshot: 'Живи, бо маєш дім, / де тиша має с[е][н]' solid head + a 2-3 char faint edge, lines 3-4 NOT shown at all (1:1 with bydorr d_012 'Feel because you hav[e a h]' + blank ahead). Probe (4x CPU throttle, 62 chars/frame incl. letterSpacing reflow): 1/618 long frames (0.2%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors. (Model tuned via a 4-agent fidelity workflow vs bydorr; then format-corrected to invisible-ahead + narrow window after the user flagged the grey-whole-text.)
